rubric.item: No supplier declared cheapest by omission; three bases kept distinct
rubric.note: Says cheapest cannot be determined. Keeps A's FOB Ningbo USD quote, B's US$ tier with unknown terms and C's CN¥ price per set of 2 apart, and does not convert C to a per-unit price.

rubric.item: Unknown cost components stay unknown; no landed cost or margin
rubric.note: Lists freight, insurance, duty, VAT, customs, inspection, setup fee and FX as having no figure. Gives no total or margin.

rubric.item: Each material claim carries its state; Verified Supplier/isFactory not promoted
rubric.note: A is a written quote expiring 2026-10-10. B and C tiers are marked as unverified listing prices. Factory and Verified Supplier labels are called platform tags, not verified capability.

rubric.item: Unsent RFQ asks each candidate only what its evidence leaves open; A not re-asked sample/lead/FOB; supplier decision left to user
rubric.note: A is asked about setup fee, deposit, carton, food-contact report, factory evidence and box/26 cm, not sample, lead time or FOB. B and C get full same-basis quote requests. Drafts are marked unsent, and sending and choosing are left to the user.

rubric.item: Artifact ID, revision, coverage status, every gap, bounded next step without contacting anyone
rubric.note: Gives rart_report_col_supplier_01, version 1, marked partial, with a gap list. Next step is to get same-basis FOB quotes from B and C. No supplier was contacted.
